I'll launch an opus subagent to review the full diff against the base ref, reading every changed file in full before judging.## Review results — cycle 3 of 5

Subagent (opus) read `git diff 0abf2297c00a90013a93ae01c6c139b7b85b1b1f..4186a96da49ff4b9c3212f64c37e81e64a6b7f00` and all 7 changed files in full, independently re-ran build/tests/fmt/clippy/grep, and mutation-verified the cycle-2 fixes were genuinely applied (not just claimed).

**Bottom line:** the production fix itself is correct — `status_cell` properly returns `(Option<Color>, is_dim)`, drops the dead `Ansi256(8)` sentinel, preserves `use_color`/`NO_COLOR` gating and the status→visual mapping, and matches the project's existing `Styles::dim` convention. All cycle-2 fixes verified as actually applied. Remaining findings are all test-coverage/polish gaps, not behavioral bugs.

### IN-SCOPE

1. **[important]** `runs/list.rs:125,131,138` — the three mechanical sites in `list_command` (RUN ID/PARENT/GOAL cells) have **zero regression coverage**. Unlike the other three files, `runs/list.rs` never extracted a testable row-builder for these cells — only `status_cell` is tested. Mutation-proven: reverting all three back to `Color::Ansi256(8)` still leaves 978/978 tests passing. Fix: extract a `fn run_row(...) -> Vec<CellStruct>` (mirroring `workflow_row`/`timeline_row`) and add a test asserting `\x1b[2m` on those cells.
2. **[minor]** `render_cell` helper (added in cycle 2) is used only in `runs/list.rs`; the other three files still call `render_row(vec![single_cell])` instead of the more direct helper.
3. **[minor]** Cyan-cell assertions (added in cycle 2) only check color presence, never assert the cell is *not* dimmed — `checkpoints.rs`, `model.rs`, `workflow/list.rs` — inconsistent with `status_cell`'s own non-dim test, which does check this. `model.rs`'s MODEL cell also never asserts `.bold()` survived.
4. **[minor]** `has_style_escape` (rewritten in cycle 2) misclassifies non-SGR CSI sequences (e.g. `\x1b[2K`) as style escapes — confirmed via direct probe. Currently inert since `cli-table` only emits SGR, but a latent false positive if reused elsewhere.
5. **[minor]** Plan doc (`docs/plans/2026-08-06-fix-text-color-plan.md`) claims `status: completed` but all 33 validation checkboxes remain unticked, including ones provably run (fmt/clippy/grep/nextest) and ones provably not (manual dark-terminal check).
6. **[minor]** Empty-goal/empty-detail edge case (`workflow_row` with `goal: None`, `timeline_row` with no details) is untested — harmless behaviorally but the one input shape the new row builders can take that nothing covers.

### OUT-OF-SCOPE (report-only)

- **A. [important, if in scope]** `workflow/list.rs::truncate_str` byte-slices UTF-8 (panic risk on multi-byte chars straddling the truncation point) — pre-existing, and disagrees with the char-safe sibling implementation in `runs/list.rs`.
- **B. [minor]** `model.rs`'s private duplicate `color_if` (deferred per the brief).
- **C. [minor]** New test modules import functions by name, technically against CLAUDE.md's "Rust import style" rule — but this matches the crate's dominant existing pattern, so it's CLAUDE.md that's out of step, not this branch.
- **D. [minor]** Unit tests force `ColorChoice::Always`, bypassing the `Auto`/`Never` table-level wiring — pre-existing structural limitation, covered by the manual repro steps instead.

One important-severity in-scope finding (#1, the untested `runs/list.rs` mechanical sites) remains — another cycle is warranted to close that gap; #2–#6 are cheap and can ride along in the same pass.
